title: Build-up changes first-year trial volume

title: Where the launch forecast is fragile
caption: One input moved at a time through the illustrative desk model; bars show the change from the 3.5 million unit central forecast. Distribution, penetration and the evoked-set judgment move the forecast most; media spend moves it least because awareness is near its plateau. Illustrative weights, not measured elasticities.
